description: Discover open-concept living in this PRE-SALE 2,230 sq. ft. 2-story home featuring 3 bedrooms, 2.25 bathrooms, a spacious loft, & a desirable homesite backing to a greenbelt! CHOOSE & PERSONALIZE your home to fit your lifestyle w/structural options such as a back patio, deluxe primary bathroom, electric fireplace, or 9' main-floor ceilings. Need more bedrooms? Choose an optional 3- or 4-bedroom configuration in lieu of the loft. The primary bedroom features a private ensuite bath & walk-in closet. Bring your vision to life in our Design Studio, where you can personalize finishes from flooring & countertops to cabinetry, fixtures, & hardware. Enjoy quality included features such as white-painted millwork, quartz countertops throughout, soft-close cabinetry doors, & LVP flooring in the entry, kitchen, bathrooms, & laundry. Your new home also includes a fully landscaped & fenced backyard w/pre-stained wood fencing & an access gate, plus an energy-efficient heat pump. These ENERGY STAR® certified homes offer exceptional efficiency & comfort. Enjoy a level of personalization & choice rarely found in this price range!
